note: Multiselect is a field widget (id 'multiselect', extends OptionsWidgetBase; field_types list_string/list_float/list_integer/entity_reference) plus a '#type => multiselect' Form API element. Its only persistent global state is config object multiselect.settings key multiselect.widths (int px, default 250). Per-field state is the entity_form_display component's type=multiselect. Medium cases seed a real list_string field with the multiselect widget and a known widths value; hard cases require switching a field's widget to multiselect and setting the width, both verified against live config. No permissions, no Drush, no plugin type.

evals.prompt: Which field types can the Drupal Multiselect module's widget be used on? List them.
evals.expected_output: The multiselect widget supports list_string, list_float, list_integer, and entity_reference fields (it extends OptionsWidgetBase with multiple_values = TRUE).

evals.prompt: Multiselect has a single global setting for the size of its two select boxes. Which config object and key hold it, what does it control, and what is the default?
evals.expected_output: Config object multiselect.settings, key multiselect.widths (integer pixels, default 250) sets the width of the Available/Selected select boxes; edited at /admin/config/content/multiselect and pushed to the browser as drupalSettings.multiselect.widths.

evals.prompt: I have a List (text) field on my Article content type. How do I make it use the Multiselect two-box widget instead of the default select?
evals.expected_output: On the bundle's Manage form display page (e.g. /admin/structure/types/manage/article/form-display) choose 'Multiselect' as that field's widget and Save; in entity_form_display the component becomes type: multiselect.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has one field whose edit widget is the Multiselect two-box selector. Inspect the live default form display for Article and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: field_ms_known — in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default its component has type: multiselect.

evals.prompt: What is the currently configured width (in pixels) of the Multiselect select boxes on this site? Inspect the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: 400 — config multiselect.settings key multiselect.widths is 400 on this site.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a List (text) field field_ms_task currently using the default 'Select list' widget. Change the default form display so field_ms_task uses the Multiselect widget instead, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default set the field_ms_task component type to 'multiselect' (via Manage form display, or setComponent(['type'=>'multiselect'])).

evals.prompt: The two boxes in my multiselect fields are too narrow. Make them 320 pixels wide across the whole site using the Multiselect module, and save it live.
evals.expected_output: Set config multiselect.settings key multiselect.widths to 320 (e.g. `drush config:set multiselect.settings multiselect.widths 320 -y`, or the /admin/config/content/multiselect form).
